zoophyte.definition: An animal thought to have the characteristics of a plant, later specifically an invertebrate of the (former) group Zoophyta, comprising sponges, corals and sea anemones.

zouave.definition: A French soldier in the Union army of the Unites States civil war, or a Union soldier in a French soldier's uniform.
